name: Nazara Technologies Limited
summary: Nazara Technologies Limited operates a gaming and sports media platform in India, Africa, the Middle East, the Asia Pacific, the United States, and internationally. It operates through Gaming, eSports, and Ad tech segments. The company offers subscriptions, download of games, and support services. It also provides gamified early learning; mobile gaming; PC and console publishing; offline entertainment; esports, indoor kids soft play/gaming and entertainment; sports medial; and digital advertising technology.
